title: S5 Phase 0.3 baseline: gameplay route (attract-long pad), 3D-only score; ship60, nat60, n4bp60 x4 at cap60 + natU x2 (info)
notes: Every run: attract-long.txt virtual-pad route (START, A, A, then idle: the attract 3D sequence), run ends at first frame + 270 s (warm-up 90 + window 180; about 274 s from launch, M12 gate needs >= 270).

Score = score3d.py: 3D reached = first frame with >= 600 draws (else VOID); window starts at the sustained anchor = first frame of >= 1.0 s with every frame >= 1500 draws (M12 S5-GATES; launch clock xenos 107.98 s, native 125.49 s in the smoke runs, offsf 128.48 s) and spans 120 s of frames (short = VOID); run.json gets window_start_s + effective_cap.

Thermals: before each run wait until the GPU is below 72 C (NVML, timeout 90 s, flag cooldown_timeout; idle floor was 68-71 C at P8 at 17:38, 58 C at 16:47; 3D runs 77-87 C); gpu.csv 1 Hz; thermal-limited share per run in results.csv (gpu_thermal_share).

Pinned bins, never modified: devfinal2-bin MANIFEST 4A4A13ED, nativefinal2-bin MANIFEST 4E5E2620 (build/agent2/final2/BIN-PINS.md), native4bp-bin MANIFEST C5181520 (build/agent16/pack, Overseer 17:51). One unscored cold run per bin before round 1, long enough (first frame + 160 s) to pass the 3D anchor so the driver-level shader cache has seen the 3D scene; every run has its own user_data_root, so no run reuses another run's game shader/PSO cache.
